newest.title: NATO’s New Theory of Victory: How AI and Drones Change Military Deterrence
newest.description: NATO’s New Theory of Victory: How AI and Drones Change Military Deterrence. NATO has unveiled a new 'Theory of Victory' that puts AI-powered drones at the center of European security. We break down what this means for the future of military deterrence and your local defense procurement news. What we covered: • NATO Drafts 'Theory of Victory' Using AI and Drones Against Eastern Flank Incursions • Norway Proposes Temporary Ban on AI Glasses in Public Spaces • Google pauses open-source bug bounty program after surge in AI-generated submissions Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: If you saw someone wearing AI glasses in a public park, would you feel your privacy was being violated? What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed. Who wins. What you do next. Follow The AI Edge on Spotify for a new AI news and analysis episode every weekday.
